surface-inverse.$description: Inverted surface, cool ink. Emphasis is inversion.

surface-raised.$description: Panels that sit above paper: provenance, ease of apply, the insight strip.

muted-inverse.$description: Secondary text on an inverted surface. Also the closed mark on ink.

line-strong.$description: The heavy panel border the canvas names directly.

control.$description: A handle a reader drags, and the rail it draws: the age strip's two bounds. One step softer than foreground, so the control reads as furniture the reader owns rather than as text. Owner's call 2026-09-13: gray.200 on ink, and its mirror on paper. Brought in with the board's AgePlot component (copied from the Index).

mark-live.$description: Verified this sweep, and re-verified. Two live states, one colour, per the legend canon.

mark-closed.$description: The closed mark. Deliberately not the loss colour: a closed posting is an honest archive record, not an alarm.

banner-stale.$description: The assurance band when the sweep is older than the freshness window. The third and last non-neutral pair: it exists because a green band over stale rows is the one lie this site cannot tell.

stat-loss.$description: The kill count and ghost rate. The only alarm colour on the site, and it is reserved for statistics, never for a row mark.

hatch-a.$description: First stripe of the verbatim-description placeholder hatch.

hatch-b.$description: Second stripe of the same hatch. Low contrast on purpose: it marks an empty slot, never fake prose.

signal.$description: The accent, used only on the primary action and the brand mark's live dot. Never on body text (it does not clear AA as text on paper).
